digest.component_or_area: tickets-store clone / CI checkout and rebar init bootstrap
propositions: A full clone of the tickets store is far larger and slower than a blob:none partial clone, dominating CI checkout time.
rebar cannot filter clones itself since all fetches are post-clone, so the size lever is the actions/checkout filter input plus clone guidance.

Adding filter: blob:none to the checkout steps that mount tickets (reconcile-bridge.yml and gerrit-verify.yaml verify-identity) reduces cost while preserving the complete commit graph for ancestry scoping.
When the tickets fetch fails, rebar init silently orphan-bootstraps a fresh empty store that diverges from origin/tickets; it must fail closed with a non-zero exit and no orphan branch.
merge.ours.driver must be defined before the filter lands, otherwise blob:none removes merge-base blobs and degrades .bridge_state merges to a text merge.
derive_caused_by must return None on any per-path git blame failure instead of electing a culprit from a partial path set.
